members.title: Members
members.inviteHint: They need an account already. Admins can register servers and manage members.
members.addFailed: Could not add them. Check the address is a registered account.
members.description: Decide who is in this organization and how much of it they reach.
members.inviteDescription: They will reach the projects their role allows.
members.roleScopedHint: Reaches every project by default. You can narrow it to a list afterwards.
members.roleFullHint: Reaches every project in the organization, including ones created later.
members.scopeSelectedHint: New projects will not be included.
members.noProjects: This organization has no projects yet.
members.scopeAllSummary: Reaches every project, including ones created later.
members.productionConsoleHint: Owners and admins always have access. Here you decide whether this developer does too.
members.allowProductionConsole: Allow access to the production console
members.allowProductionConsoleHint: Only in the projects assigned to them. Without this permission, they will work on a temporary copy of production.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Organization name
settings.nameHint: Shown wherever this organization appears. The address does not change.
settings.deleteHint: Permanent. Move or delete its projects and servers first — the deletion is refused while any remain. A paid plan ends at that moment and is not renewed; a charge from the last 14 days can be refunded as the refund policy says.
settings.deleteFailed: Could not delete it. It probably still holds projects or servers.

backupStorage.title: Backups
backupStorage.ownBucketHint: Optional. If you set one up, your backups are copied here too, on top of the platform's destinations.
backupStorage.endpointInvalid: This has to be a URL, starting with https://
backupStorage.secretWarning: The secret key cannot be read back once saved. Changing it means typing both keys again.
backupStorage.saved: Saved. We tested the connection before accepting it.
backupStorage.subtitle: Where a copy of every backup is kept off your servers, and what each project takes up.
backupStorage.locationsHint: Every copy is kept in each active location.
backupStorage.noLocations: Your plan keeps backups on your servers only. Locations off them come with a paid plan.

why.notBought: An additional copy of every backup in another region. Added from Billing.

backupStorage.byProjectHint: What each project's backups take up in each location, largest first.
backupStorage.locationsWithVault: Every copy is kept in the primary location. Each week, one copy is also kept in an immutable location, with an independent provider.
